title: Fourier mass outside the empty family
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and let the rational parameter $\varepsilon$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\leq1/2$. The total Fourier weight of $f$ is not at most $\varepsilon/2$; equivalently, its Fourier spectrum is not concentrated outside the empty family to tolerance $\varepsilon/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
